issue.title: Record short and frontmatter-only prompt drafts instead of silently dropping them from history

task_type_fields.proposal: Record short (<5 word) and frontmatter-only prompt drafts as cancelled prompt history (or another recoverable surface) instead of dropping them. Today `add_or_update_prompt` returns early when `store.is_recordable_prompt(text)` is false (`src/sase/history/prompt_store_mutations.py`), so a short cancelled draft, or one that is only frontmatter, is not recorded anywhere. Decide whether to record them as cancelled-only history rows, store them with an `allow_short`-style flag that the history picker filters by default, or send them to Stash.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved sase-1ca plan listed this under "Out of scope and follow-up candidates". The history threshold exists to keep noise out of prompt history, so changing what counts as recordable is a product decision separate from sase-1ca's data-loss fixes for the prompt stash.

issue.creation_reason: The approved sase-1ca plan listed this as an out-of-scope follow-up candidate, and no phase worker recorded it, so the sase-1ca land agent routed it as a proposal.
